messages:
Samira Khan: Quick thread on tooltip/legend behavior: compact axis units look fine but tooltips are inconsistent across chart sizes. Sometimes hover shows 1.2K, sometimes full 1,234.
Liam O'Neill: I saw that too. It's from reusing axis formatter for hover. We should separate formatters.
Priya Singh: For accessibility, hover must expose full numeric value to screen readers. Visual can remain compact.
Samira Khan: Proposal: default tooltip primary line = full number (1,234), secondary muted line = compact (1.23K) + unit. Keeps both humans and screen readers happy.
Liam O'Neill: For sparklines we might only show compact to save space, but add a focusable "more" to reveal full value. Keyboard users must be able to access it.
Priya Singh: Also: when an outlier skews the y-axis we should offer a "Clamp outliers" toggle per-chart. If enabled, show a small legend badge and an explanatory tooltip: "Extreme values trimmed to surface trends. Hover for raw values."
Samira Khan: Visual tweak: increase major gridline contrast for light theme (#D0D7DE) and tokenized for dark theme.
accessibility-bot: Reminder: add aria-label that reads full value in words, e.g., "one thousand two hundred thirty-four requests per minute".
Liam O'Neill: I'll open an RFC with acceptance criteria (hover shows full value, compact secondary line, clamp toggle + badge, gridline tokens). ETA tomorrow AM.
Priya Singh: I'll draft the aria copy and keyboard behavior notes.
Samira Khan: Thanks, team. Ping me for copy tweaks. :thumbsup:
